description: Compute shortest paths, isochrones, OD matrices, and facility service coverage from OSM or user-provided road networks. Supports drive/walk/cycle modes, road closures, and population coverage analysis. Use when the user needs travel-time analysis, service area delineation, or road network criticality assessment.
